Push (write_file, edit_file), `benmore delete-file` and `benmore check` build the browser bundles a change affects with the same esbuild options and static/ containment as the page request, so a bundle that cannot build is refused with esbuild's message and file:line:col instead of reaching visitors as a module that throws. Refused: a syntax error, an import outside static/ (`refusing to read a file outside static/`), an import that resolves to no file (`Could not resolve "./lib/x"`), a named import the module does not export (`No matching export`), a bare package import with no file behind it (`Could not resolve "react"`), and JSX elements whose runtime (react/jsx-runtime) is not in static/.

Which bundles: every .tsx, .ts or .jsx under static/ is servable as /static/<name>.js, so each is checked, as are the files that import the changed one (through relative imports; a file with a bare import counts as importing anything). Not checked: .d.ts files, tests kept in static/ (x.test.ts, x.spec.ts, __tests__/), and the MCP Apps module a connector widget component imports (the widget build supplies it). A script over 1 MiB (a vendored bundle) is not read: any name imported from it is accepted. A static/ tree with more than 10,000 files, over 64 MiB of scripts, or a directory symlink is not judged.

A write is refused for errors in the written file. Push the imported module first, then the file that imports it. A batch that defers its reload (`benmore deploy`, and a multi-file `benmore push` whose later files are static/ or HTML files) may write the importer first: there only an import outside static/ is refused, and the answer's `check` (ok:false) reports the rest until the batch's later files supply them; the CLI fails the push if any remain when the batch ends.

Errors a write leaves in OTHER files (a module that drops an export another file imports) are not refused, so an export renamed together with its import can be pushed one file at a time; the write's answer reports them (`check`, source `bundle`, ok:false) and push exits non-zero until the importing file is fixed.

delete_file / `benmore delete-file` refuses a static/ module another script still imports (`refusing to delete static/views/notes.tsx: ... static/app.tsx:17:26: Could not resolve "./views/notes"`). Change or delete the importing files first.
`benmore check` reports every failing bundle as an error filed on the file the error is in (source `bundle`); `benmore test` counts it as a failed source check.
Types are not checked: esbuild strips them. Run tsc against src/bm.d.ts in your editor for type errors.
